en.headline: Police arrest 44 in operation against triad phone scam and money laundering
en.dek: A two-day Organised Crime and Triad Bureau action codenamed Thunder 2026 targeted a Wo Shing Wo-controlled fake customer-service call centre, a hotel-based laundering operation and illegal gambling dens, involving at least 65 cases.
body: Police said the Organised Crime and Triad Bureau mounted Operation Thunder 2026 over Monday and Tuesday, arresting 44 people in connection with a triad-controlled telephone fraud and money-laundering syndicate.

Officers raided a phone scam centre in a Kwai Chung industrial building where callers posed as electronic payment platform customer service staff and claimed insurance policies were about to renew and auto-debit. At least 65 cases involving losses of about HK$11 million were linked to the centre. Seven local men aged 16 to 28 were detained there.

The same triad group operated a money-laundering centre using hotel rooms in West Kowloon that changed every few days, processing about HK$4 million a month over six months, and ran underground gambling venues in Tsim Sha Tsui and Yau Ma Tei. A further 37 people were arrested in related raids, with computers, phones, bank cards and gambling equipment seized.
The investigation is continuing and further arrests are not ruled out. Police urged the public not to provide personal or banking details to unsolicited callers and to verify any suspicious contacts.

zh.headline: 警方雷霆2026行動拘44人 搞三合會電騙及洗黑錢中心
zh.dek: 有組織罪案及三合會調查科一連兩日行動，瓦解和勝和控制的假冒客服電話詐騙中心、西九龍酒店洗黑錢中心及非法賭檔，最少涉65宗案件。
body: 警方表示，有組織罪案及三合會調查科周一至周二展開代號「雷霆2026」執法行動，拘捕44人，針對一個三合會揍控的電話詐騙及洗黑錢集團。
人員搞破葵涌工業區一個電話詐騙中心，騙徒假冒電子支付平台客服，訛稱受害人購買的保險即將到期並自動扣費。中心最少涉65宗案件，損失約1100萬元，當場拘捕7名16至28歲本地男子。
同一三合會在西九龍以酒店房間運作洗黑錢中心，每隔數日更換地點，半年來每月清洗約400萬元，並經營尖沙咀及油麻地地下賭場。相關搜查再拘捕37人，檢獲電腦、電話、他人銀行卡及賭具。
調查仍在進行，不排除更多人被捕。警方提醒市民勿向可疑來電提供個人或銀行資料，並善用防騙工具核實。
